response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT c."circuitId", c."country", COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r."circuitId" = c."circuitId" WHERE r."date" BETWEEN '1978-03-04' AND '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c."circuitId", c."country") SELECT "circuitId", "country", race_count, CAST(race_count AS REAL) / AVG(race_count) OVER (PARTITION BY "country") AS ratio FROM circuit_counts ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
